title: [Bug]: a throwing beforeVerify/beforeSettle hook is ignored, so extension gates fail open
quote: When a resource-server hook throws in beforeVerify or beforeSettle, the exception is logged and the loop continues as if the hook had passed. The payment then verifies and settles normally.

title: fix(core): fail closed when a gate hook throws
quote: A throw in those two phases now stops the payment with reason extension_hook_error and the thrown message. The warning log stays. Advisory phases (after*, on*Failure, enrichment) still log and continue.

title: feat(go): facilitator-managed voucher custody for EVM batch settlement
quote: EVM batch-settlement can now let the facilitator hold the vouchers. The resource server checks each payment and forwards it; the facilitator stores the voucher, claims, settles, and refunds. The old mode, where the server holds the vouchers, stays the default.

title: docs(specs): add facilitator-managed voucher mode to EVM batch-settlement (v1.1)
quote: Updates the EVM batch-settlement spec (v1.1) to add an optional facilitator-managed mode. In this mode the facilitator, not the resource server, stores the latest voucher and decides when to claim and settle onchain.

title: [Feature]: Card acceptance as an auth-capture network binding
quote: Every network binding in x402 today is a crypto rail, so a buyer without a funded wallet cannot pay. Cards are what most buyers, and the agents paying on their behalf, already hold. On the wire, network is a CAIP-2 identifier card:<card-network> (for example card:visa) with the PSP in extra.psp... No card data travels in the payload.

title: spec(auth-capture): propose card network binding
quote: The draft was reviewed in the card acceptance working group and cut down to the base binding: an opaque PSP token, a hold before the resource runs, then a capture or void. The five open items are listed at the top of the spec with their options.
